description:
Canadian Protein, Canada's highest quality source to buy whey protein supplements, vegan protein, and nutritional and bodybuilding supplements, is invitng you to be one of our paid brand affiliates! 🏋️‍♀️✨

Sign up to be an affiliate here https://Canadianprotein.com/pages/affiliate-program and earn a 5% monetary commission on every sale made through your affiliate link! Plus you'll be receiving a 10% commission on total referral sales when a customer makes a first-time purchase. You also have the chance to level up to our Super Influencer Tier by reaching $1000-worth of sales on your link and earn 10% commission on every purchase made through your affiliate link. 

We hope you can get on board with us. Let's reach our fitness goals together!
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Canadian Protein! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links

Affiliate link is automatically generated and also editable, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts. The discount attached to your affiliate links is reliant on the on-going promo/sale on the Canadian Protein website. Hence, it may vary at times. Likewise, the said discounts are temporarily turned off during big discount promos/sales on the website so as to avoid discount stacking. 

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, TikTok, Youtube,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission of 10% for first time customers and 5% after the same customers first order. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fees (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings by adding your PayPal email in your Payment Method tab. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page which is 30 days after a month's performance.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: affiliates@canadianprotein.com


8. Changes to the program: 

Canadian Protein reserves the right to apply changes and updates to the program without prior notice.


9. Confidentiality

As an Affiliate, you may receive confidential information about Canadian Protein, including business practices and other sensitive details. You agree not to share or use this information for anything other than fulfilling your obligations under this agreement, unless you have written permission from Canadian Protein.

This obligation continues even after the partnership ends. Canadian Protein may seek legal remedies, including injunctions, to protect its confidential information in case of any breach.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to Affiliates@CanadianProtein.com for support.
